interpretation_limits: Five checkpoint executions of each of four positive pairs are repeated measurements, not 20 independent terrain tests.
Both changed-light positive pairs also use unseen-roll cameras; this tiny pilot cannot isolate lighting from geometry/roll.
Native-pixel Euclidean candidate distances do not prove pose recoverability or local-refinement success.
The 33x33 refinement search is centered on rounded rotated candidate coordinates; Euclidean <=16px is a conservative disk, not the exact square support certificate.
Initial candidate rank 0 does not prove identical initial assignment vectors; exact initial vectors were not recorded. Earliest diversity snapshot is after the first measurement.
Missing coarse outputs on blank-image early return cannot be replaced with ground truth recomputation.
A returned solar_supported flag describes the recorded likelihood support test, not independently verified query Sun accuracy.
Requested B/C flags do not establish execution or benefit; actual C fallback was not recorded by the frozen solver.
This is a cost-pilot diagnosis and does not select a checkpoint or establish accuracy improvement.
